tonight.headline: Pickens is yours and plays tonight in your flex; Tuten is still on the bench
body: Bad news first. You are 0–4, the claim cost what it was priced at, last place in a waiver order that never resets, and Tuten, 3.1 above Gordon, is on your bench for the fourth brief running. Barkley is now expected to miss London by Rapoport's account.

The claim itself went through at 01:25: Pickens for Downs. He is in the flex, which is where the projection puts him, 13.3 to Golden's 12.7, and he kicks off at 18:15 tonight against Tampa Bay. There is nothing to change before then. As set you project 115.8 against 123.3 and ESPN gives you 46%. The one move left this week is Tuten for Gordon, before 07:30 on Sunday.

case.label: Tonight
case.body: Dallas are 7.5-point favourites with a total of 47.5 (Covers, 8 Oct 07:31 ET). Pickens has no injury designation and Dak Prescott is healthy. Tampa Bay have allowed the fourth-fewest points to receivers in standard scoring and no 250-yard passing game (FootballDB; RotoWire). CeeDee Lamb drew 21 targets last week to Pickens's 3.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Nacua 21.7, Goff 18.5, Kyren Williams 17.9, Jeremiyah Love 15.1 and officially limited on Wednesday with an ankle, Tee Higgins 14.3 after missing practice when he was expected to be limited, Watson 13.8, Kittle 13.7. Their defence is still Kansas City's, on bye at 0.0, so their number rises when they fix it. None of their starters plays tonight.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Higgins or Love sitting, on their side. On yours, nothing on Wednesday's reports touches a projected starter; setting Tuten adds 3.1.

case.label: What the check says
case.body: lineup_check.py: start Tuten over Gordon, PROJECTION, 3.1 points. It is the only difference between your lineup and the projection's. As set you project 115.8; the projection lineup is 118.9.

case.label: Why Tuten
case.body: 17 of Jacksonville's 23 backfield carries in Week 4 (archive), and he is not on Jacksonville's Wednesday report (jaguars.com; PhillyVoice, 7 Oct). Jacksonville are 7 to 7.5-point favourites in London against an Eagles team that had three defenders out of practice, traded its centre and starts a rookie at right tackle.

case.label: Why not Gordon
case.body: Nobody in Miami has named a starter or described a split; the one 'expected to start' line is an outlet's projection with no date. 9 carries for 100 last week, more than half on one run. Miami are 7-point underdogs. You spent a claim on him and a start would count toward that thesis; that is not a reason to give up three points.

case.label: The flex is settled
case.body: Pickens holds it at 13.3 and locks tonight. Golden, 12.7, is 0.6 behind: a coin flip that went to the projection, with nothing written down.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Gordon outscores Tuten on Sunday (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: Tuten is still on the bench behind Gordon
whatWentWrong.lead: Tuesday's card has not been acted on in four briefs. It is 3.1 points and it locks first, at 07:30 on Sunday.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: lineup_check.py on the 12:49 UTC file: 115.8 as set, 118.9 for the projection lineup. All 3.1 is Tuten over Gordon.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The only card today.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Miami coach naming Gordon the starter and ESPN moving him above Tuten. Neither has happened.

whatWentWrong.title: The claim landed, and you are now last in the waiver order for the season
whatWentWrong.lead: Pickens for Downs processed at 01:25. Your priority went from 7th to 10th and it never resets.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Activity log, 07:25 UTC: WAIVER_ADD George Pickens, WAIVER_DROP Josh Downs. The league file shows your waiver rank as 10. So the six managers ahead of you all passed on him.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Every later claim. From here anything worth having has to clear waivers first or be a free agent, which is how the tight end and the defence were handled this week. It also makes today's card matter more: the points you can still add are in the lineup, not on the wire.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing restores the priority. The claim is graded on Pickens against Downs over Weeks 5 to 7.

worthALook.name: Brenton Strange
worthALook.lead: You held him for three hours on Wednesday. Free again, level with Loveland, and not a move.

case.label: The role
case.body: 7 catches on 8 targets for 95 on 87% of the snaps in Week 4, with every Jacksonville pass-catcher healthy (archive; PlayerProfiler). Targets 3, 2, 5, 8.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 9.7, the same as Loveland, and the seat changed twice on Wednesday. Philadelphia allow the fifth-fewest points to tight ends and Jacksonville are off in Week 7; Loveland has no bye until Week 10. FantasyPros advises against chasing him this week.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Loveland ruled out. Nothing else reopens the seat before 14 Oct.

worthALook.sources: Week 1–4 archive · PlayerProfiler · FantasyPros · activity log

worthALook.name: T.J. Hockenson
worthALook.lead: The highest-projected free tight end. Jefferson says he intends to play, which takes targets back.

case.label: The role
case.body: 13 catches on 13 targets for 119 with Jefferson out (archive). On Wednesday Jefferson was limited and said he intends to play; Jordan Addison did not practise with a hamstring (vikings.com; RotoWire, 7 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 10.4 against Loveland's 9.7 is a coin flip, the seat is closed, and Minnesota are off in Week 6, which would empty the slot again in five days.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Loveland ruled out and Jefferson ruled out with him.

worthALook.sources: Week 1–4 archive · vikings.com · ESPN league file

worthALook.name: Will Shipley
worthALook.lead: The handcuff to your Barkley, who is expected to miss London. He shares the work with Dameon Pierce.

case.label: The role
case.body: Barkley did not practise and Rapoport expects him to miss Sunday; Bigsby is on injured reserve until at least Week 9. Shipley took both goal-to-go carries in Week 4 (FantasyLife, 8 Oct). ESPN projects him 10.2.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Dameon Pierce was signed to the 53 and Nick Sirianni called him 'an NFL starting running back' (wire, 7 Oct), so the work is shared. 15 carries all season. 10.2 is below Tuten, Kamara and Gordon, and no seat is open that is not a starter or protected.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley going on injured reserve. Then the seat question is asked again; with Downs gone, the only unprotected seat left is Golden's, and he is not a drop for a handcuff.

worthALook.sources: Philadelphia Inquirer · PFT · RotoWire · Week 4 archive

worthALook.name: Cowboys D/ST
worthALook.lead: The highest-projected free defence, 0.7 above the Jaguars. They play tonight, so it closes at 18:15.

case.label: The role
case.body: Dallas host Tampa Bay tonight. Baker Mayfield is out and an undrafted rookie starts; FantasyPros ranked Dallas 1st on Tuesday, FantasyData has them 11th. The spread has come in from −10 to −7.5.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 0.7 is a coin flip and the defence seat changed on Wednesday. Dallas ruled out cornerback Cobie Durant and linebacker DeMarvion Overshown.

case.label: What would change it

waiverAnalysis.summary: The same eight names clear the tool's bar as on Wednesday, and at running back and receiver the bar is an artefact: it measures them against Barkley and Rice, whose last week was an injury exit each. Four weeks of data. Nothing reported overnight changes a role reason and none of the eight is a move; after last night's claim you are also last in the waiver order. The tool never printed George Pickens, who was claimed on the activity log's evidence.

rising.name: Keaton Mitchell
rising.roleReason: A three-man rotation by design: 10 carries and 5 catches in Week 4, with Omarion Hampton at 9 carries and Kimani Vidal 5 (FantasyPros, 5 Oct). None of the three is on Wednesday's report; the Chargers' line is thin, with Joe Alt not expected to play. Off in Week 7.
rising.action: WATCH — a committee third; the trigger is Hampton missing a game

rising.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
rising.roleReason: Bijan Robinson is healthy: 19 carries for 145 and two touchdowns on Monday beside Brian's 14 for 62 and three (FantasyPros, 6 Oct). No coach has described a split, and Atlanta's only backfield move overnight was on the practice squad.
rising.action: WATCH — touchdowns and game script behind a healthy starter

rising.name: MarShawn Lloyd
rising.roleReason: He and Kaleb Johnson both fumbled in Week 4 and Matt LaFleur says fumblers sit. Chris Brooks (ankle) did not practise on Wednesday (packers.com). No ruling on Josh Jacobs was found, and nothing on him is dated after 1 Sep. You dropped Lloyd for Gordon.
rising.action: WATCH — volume at 1.9 yards a carry in a backfield nobody has won

rising.name: Mike Washington Jr.
rising.roleReason: Ashton Jeanty's handcuff: 9 carries for 18 on a season-high 18 snaps while Jeanty left briefly with an ankle and returned. Jeanty practised in full on Wednesday by raiders.com; this morning's pass found no newer item on him.
rising.action: WATCH — nothing unless Jeanty's ankle costs him a practice

rising.name: Devaughn Vele
rising.roleReason: 6 catches on 9 targets for 54 and a touchdown while Shough threw 48 times from behind. Jordyn Tyson is on injured reserve. On Wednesday Shough was limited with a wrapped left hand and Chris Olave rested. The steadiest role on this list, against Minnesota's defence.
rising.action: WATCH — a real role, as a sixth receiver; there is no seat

rising.name: Khalil Shakir
rising.roleReason: 7 catches on 8 targets in the game DJ Moore left with an aggravated AC joint. Buffalo play on Monday and have still published no report, so Moore's status is unknown; Keon Coleman is the Bill the columns prefer.
rising.action: WATCH — depends on Moore sitting, and Buffalo's first report is due today

rising.name: Tyquan Thornton
rising.roleReason: Dislocated his left ankle in Week 4; out 12 to 16 weeks with surgery this week (FantasyPros, 5 Oct 16:08 ET). The tool still prints him because his last game was his biggest.
rising.action: WATCH — off the list: out until at least January

rising.name: Keon Coleman
rising.roleReason: 6 catches on 7 targets for 116 and a touchdown after DJ Moore left. The role is exactly as long as Moore's absence, and Buffalo's first report is due today.
rising.action: WATCH — a role that exists only while Moore is out
